in_sanskrit.name: Vishanu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector of the World
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vishanu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Vishanu signifies the protector of the world. It is one of the names of Lord Vishnu, the preserver deity in Hinduism. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vish' meaning protection and 'Nu' meaning new or young. Thus, Vishanu is the young protector or the preserver.
